system.description: You find the very idea of drinking blood repulsive. Immediately after feeding you must make a Static Physical Challenge against six Traits; failure means you suddenly and messily vomit up all the Blood Traits you just consumed. The only way to hold vitae down without the challenge is to feed while in frenzy, when your Beast keeps it down for you — at the cost of the mess and the Masquerade risk that comes with feeding while frenzying.
